mapper.select: SELECT fuel_test_bill_no as fuelTestBillNo, fuel_date as fuelDate, fuel_name as fuelName, fuel_temp as fuelTemp, fuel_dnst as fuelDnst, fuel_airport_code as fuelAirportCode, fuel_staff_name as fuelStaffName, fuel_logic_del_flg as fuelLogicDelFlg FROM T_FUEL WHERE fuel_date > STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), '04:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and fuel_airport_code = #{staffAirportCode}

SELECT fuel_test_bill_no as fuelTestBillNo, fuel_date as fuelDate, fuel_name as fuelName, fuel_temp as fuelTemp, fuel_dnst as fuelDnst, fuel_airport_code as fuelAirportCode, fuel_staff_name as fuelStaffName, fuel_logic_del_flg as fuelLogicDelFlg FROM T_FUEL WHERE fuel_test_bill_no = #{fuel.fuelTestBillNo} and fuel_airport_code = #{fuel.fuelAirportCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT into T_FUEL(fuel_test_bill_no, fuel_date, fuel_name, fuel_temp, fuel_dnst, fuel_airport_code, fuel_staff_name, fuel_logic_del_flg) values (#{fuel.fuelTestBillNo}, #{fuel.fuelDate}, #{fuel.fuelName}, #{fuel.fuelTemp}, #{fuel.fuelDnst}, #{fuel.fuelAirportCode}, #{staffName}, 1)
mapper.update: update T_FUEL set fuel_name=#{fuel.fuelName}, fuel_temp=#{fuel.fuelTemp}, fuel_dnst=#{fuel.fuelDnst}, fuel_date=#{fuel.fuelDate}, fuel_staff_name=#{staffName}, fuel_logic_del_flg= 1 where fuel_test_bill_no = #{fuel.fuelTestBillNo} and fuel_airport_code = #{fuel.fuelAirportCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, fuel_test_bill_no AS fuelTestBillNo, fuel_date AS fuelDate, fuel_name AS fuelName, fuel_temp AS fuelTemp, fuel_dnst AS fuelDnst, fuel_type AS fuelType, fuel_pub_type AS fuelPubType, fuel_airport_code AS fuelAirportCode, fuel_check_name AS fuelCheckName, fuel_staff_name AS fuelStaffName, fuel_logic_del_flg AS fuelLogicDelFlg FROM (SELECT * FROM `T_FUEL` WHERE fuel_logic_del_flg = 0 AND fuel_date <= NOW() AND fuel_airport_code = #{staffAirportCode} ORDER BY fuel_date DESC LIMIT 100) MAX GROUP BY fuel_pub_type, fuel_type ORDER BY fuel_type ASC

SELECT id AS id, fuel_test_bill_no AS fuelTestBillNo, fuel_date AS fuelDate, fuel_name AS fuelName, fuel_temp AS fuelTemp, fuel_dnst AS fuelDnst, fuel_type AS fuelType, fuel_pub_type AS fuelPubType, fuel_airport_code AS fuelAirportCode, fuel_check_name AS fuelCheckName, fuel_staff_name AS fuelStaffName, fuel_logic_del_flg AS fuelLogicDelFlg FROM `T_FUEL` WHERE fuel_date > NOW() AND fuel_airport_code = #{staffAirportCode} ORDER BY fuel_date asc, fuel_type ASC

select fuel_test_bill_no as fuelTestBillNo, fuel_date as fuelDate, fuel_name as fuelName, fuel_temp as fuelTemp, fuel_dnst as fuelDnst, fuel_airport_code as fuelAirportCode, fuel_staff_name as fuelStaffName, fuel_logic_del_flg as fuelLogicDelFlg from T_FUEL where fuel_date = #{date}
